arguments.message: When you create a new record, the search index is updated a short time after the record is saved. Browsing shows the record immediately, but search can lag by a few minutes under normal load. In most cases the record will appear in search on its own within a couple of minutes—no action is needed. If it still isn’t showing after several minutes, that’s not normal indexing lag and you should report the issue for further investigation.
